The '''KT-series''' was a model of<ref name="The Droids Re-Animated" /> [[Class two droid/Legends|second-degree]]<ref name="TNEGTD" /> [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[KT-10]] was an offshoot of this series.<ref name="The Droids Re-Animated" />
